slot_note: Numbered from seed RC08 (a wind turbine's five faults and its one spring crew visit). Architecture 1 (an NHS Talking Therapies service) died at stage 4 on the judge's SEND_BACK and architecture 2 (a bowel screening hub's equity fund) at stage 2 on honest levels (lineage). Architecture 3 moves domain, world, dataset and shell to a cold-climate electric membership cooperative's distribution system, keeping the decision kind (one of five changes gets the single fix) and the quantity's kind (what the change cost over the review year, in the period's natural unit).
niche: a cold-climate electric membership cooperative's 2027 reliability work plan: which of five changes in the twelve months to 30 September 2026 cost its members the most sustained interruptions, when the control centre's revised switching template picked sections up in one step and sections restored that way after a long outage in hard frost tripped again within minutes on the cold load they took, overload trips the heat pump connection policy is blamed for
answer: Fund the 2027 fix for the SO-7 restoration switching revision: about 8,700 sustained customer interruptions in fiscal 2026, 7,200 more than the runner-up, the heat pumps connected without a load study (about 1,500).
analyst_test: A strong analyst who reads every field and the work plan policy correctly counts the year's IEEE 1366 sustained interruptions outside major event days by cause, books the overload category's rise (about 10,900) to the heat pump connection policy as the one change that adds load, and costs the SO-7 switching revision at nothing because it only shortens restorations; the step they skip is pairing each trip with the same section's restoration minutes before.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the sustained interruptions that cold load pickup re-trips added once sections were re-energised in one step: a long outage in hard frost leaves every electric heating load calling at once, a section picked up in one step draws two to four times its diversified load and its protection trips again within minutes, which distribution reliability engineering counts in IEEE 1366 customer interruptions; swapped to another field's nouns there is no loss of load diversity, no relay pickup and no restoration practice for the pairing to rest on.
layer1: an outage management extract whose interruptions are logged in local time across the daylight saving changes and whose multi-step restorations sit in a separate step table
momentary operations under five minutes mixed into the device log beside sustained interruptions
five years of daily SAIDI history whose earliest two years come from the retired outage system in a different layout
a section and device register re-keyed in a GIS migration, with a crosswalk
heat pump rebate connections keyed by service address and meter, not by section
weather from an airport station in UTC hours
stakeholder_role: manager of system reliability at the cooperative

spine.entity: one sustained interruption record (unplanned or planned) in the outage management system

world.geography: United States, central Minnesota (no county named)
world.org_type: an electric membership cooperative distributing to about 136,000 members

driver: The decisive quantity is the interruptions a change in how units are brought back caused by making them fail again moments after they return: the second failure is filed under the cause its aftermath resembles, so a change whose stated effect is only on duration is costed at nothing on counts while the change that added load takes the rise, and only pairing each failure with the same unit's return minutes before separates them.
driver_concrete: Each fiscal 2026 overload trip set against the same section's restoration minutes earlier: after the control centre's switching template SO-7 was revised on 1 December 2025 to shorten restorations, sections re-energised in one step after a long outage in hard frost tripped again within minutes on the cold load they picked up, re-interrupting the same members; those re-trips (about 8,700 customer interruptions), not the heat pumps connected without a load study (whose own harm is about 1,500 on the service transformers a study checks), are most of the winter's overload rise.
stump: A solver who books fiscal 2026's sustained interruptions by cause files the heat pump connection policy, at about 10,900 customer interruptions, because the overload category rose most once heat pumps were connected without a load study, and costs the switching revision at nothing because it only shortens restorations; the step that lands them there is never pairing each overload trip with the same section's restoration minutes earlier, which shows most of the winter's rise as cold-load re-trips after one-step re-energisation began and puts the fix on the switching revision.

differentiation.task252: task252 reads a channel's error recovering after each maintenance visit against an upstream reference; here nothing is calibrated: each interruption is paired with the same section's restoration minutes before, and the call names the restoration practice whose restored supply does not hold.
differentiation.task129: task129 books a vegetation rise to a trimming contractor and finds it in each unit's surroundings beyond the cleared zone; here no surroundings decide: the rise is a second interruption the restoration itself sets off, found only by pairing each trip with the same section's return minutes before.
differentiation.task303: task303 removes the losses every sibling feeder logs in the same minute from a shared upstream source; here the pairing is within one section across time, a trip minutes after its own restoration, and the call names the change in restoration practice.
differentiation.task400: task400 reads a staggered rollout through the natural comparison of units adopting at different dates; here nothing is staggered and no comparison group decides: the decisive variable is the minutes between consecutive records of one section, a restoration setting off the next interruption on the same device.

lineage.architecture: v1 (Psychology and Behavioural Science: a charity-run NHS Talking Therapies service's 2025-26 fall in recoveries, agency high-intensity cover on 12-week blocks breaking step 3 courses, read as the waiting list's)

world.geography: England, a fictional county integrated care board area
world.org_type: a mental health charity delivering the county's NHS Talking Therapies service under contract to the integrated care board (stepped care, steps 2 and 3)

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the share of a long wait's apparent harm that runs through the actor the waiting cases were given to, whose fixed-term assignment lapsed mid-case so the case was handed on and abandoned, against the wait's direct path, read only by setting each case's run of actors against the assignment register; because the arrangement was used on the longest-waiting cases, the loss reads as the wait's.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each step 3 course's run of high-intensity therapists, rebuilt from the care contacts across the record migration, set against the agency booking log's assignment ends: the courses an agency block's lapse broke off lose most of their patients after the reallocation, the wait's direct path is about zero among courses whose therapist stayed, and because agency cover took the backlog the loss reads as the waiting list's.
lineage.stump: A solver who walks the fall down the referral-to-recovery funnel finds it in step 3 courses ending early, sees early endings rise with the wait while agency therapists' recovery rates match employed ones, and files C, the waiting list; the step that lands it there is never splitting the wait's effect by setting each course's run of therapists against the agency booking log, which puts the loss on the courses a lapsing agency block broke off and the call on A.
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-03 at stage 4: judge SEND_BACK, Gate H rule_application (the filed per-change cost, executed with any-contact exposure, lands A at 250), ask 4 conventions unfiled. Measured: the plan filed each change's cost as expected minus actual recoveries read from the year's other referrals at the same step, largest wins; any-contact exposure gives A 249, the naive comparator 267, the golden 257 (all 250 to the nearest 50), last-clinician exposure 222; change C had no filed in-place date or wait threshold and tied A at 248 to 257 on the same patients; ask 4's monthly agency hours needed unfiled conventions (a dropped old booking, the later of two portal timesheets before 1 August and summing after, catch-up lumps spread over unclaimed weeks, working-day allocation, week-commencing moving June by about 1,200 hours); Gate F low to moderate.

lineage.architecture: v2 (Epidemiology and Public Health: a regional bowel cancer screening hub's 2026-27 equity fund, kits despatched while an address change sat pending in the shared registration service's queue going to the address the person had left, a loss at one rate in both compared years)

world.org_type: an NHS foundation trust hosting the region's bowel cancer screening hub

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is what a change in force through both compared years costs every year through a cohort no column marks, members whose change of record was still pending when their summons was sent and who were summoned at a place they had left; a comparison of the year against the last gives it nothing, because its loss is a level and not a movement, while the changes dated between the years take the year-on-year fall.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each 2025-26 kit set against the shared registration service's own work queue: where an address change had been asked for before the kit was despatched and was applied after it, the kit went to the address the person had left and almost never came back completed; that loss runs at the same rate in 2024-25 and 2025-26, so costing each change against 2024-25 gives the shared service nothing while the reminder change takes the fall.
lineage.stump: A solver who age-standardises completion by deprivation fifth and costs each change against 2024-25 files the reminder moved to eight weeks for the most deprived fifth's lost screens and sets the shared registration service aside as in force through both years; the step that lands them there is never setting each kit's despatch date against the person's pending address change, which shows the most deprived fifth losing more screens to kits sent to the address the person had left than to any change on the review, so the fund goes to the shared registration service.

notes: Strategy time_semantics: the decisive move is an as-of relation between records, each fiscal 2026 overload trip set against the same section's last restoration minutes before it; no field carries those minutes, no key joins a trip to the restoration before it, and no filed rule computes them. decomposition_attribution stays the Gate G mechanism: the year's overload rise splits between heat pump load (true overloads on the service transformers a load study checks) and cold load pickup re-trips after one-step restoration, and only that pairing decides the split. three_rules.strategy_risk WARN (time_semantics) answered: reading every field right still files the heat pump policy, because the relation that moves the call is between rows. Decisive generator G9 (downstream survival against upstream acquisition): the restoration is the acquisition the revision's own measure times; whether the restored supply held is the outcome the decision is scored on. G14 (conditioned yield) behind it: the staged-era rate applies only to restorations after a long outage in frost. G3 (record against operation) was refused by ban.pattern against task400; G7 and population-first gaps collide with task202 and task308. org_family cooperative_or_member_body is the honest key for a member-owned cooperative (task129 and task308 carry it); utility_or_infrastructure is banned against task401 and is not used. Stage 3 (2026-11-03): heart BLOCKed four axes against task398 once task401's architecture 3 was spent and left the window (ban.role, ban.artifact, ban.strategy, ban.forum). Redrawn: the work plan is adopted by the cooperative's elected Board of Trustees (the pack's documents now name it so); the manager of system reliability sits in system planning (capacity_planner, research_desk was the looser fit); the stakeholder's context artifact is the fiscal year's reliability review, a close-out of the year (close_out_summary); the decisive variable is the minutes between a trip and the same section's last restoration, a relation in time between records (time_semantics), with decomposition_attribution kept as the Gate G mechanism. Stage 4 fix pass (2026-11-03): the re-trips now follow outages of two and a quarter hours or more on days averaging -7 C or colder at both ends, so every pairing operationalisation (windows 5 to 30 minutes, qualifying outages 30 to 120 minutes, eleven frost filters, overload or every trip, three pairings, three nettings) prints the same cost; the prompt's second sentence keeps its opener.
